what: MM1-v2's forecasts for E207's 53 points (THE BLIND MATMUL DAY: aifoundry3 card 0 at its pinned 600 MHz, rgm136 unchanged), from the frozen predictor in tools/matmul/mm1/v2 unchanged
V_why: the predictor's own default for this card (mm1_core_v2.CARD_V, 0.522 V: the footing of MM1-v2's aifoundry3 fit and of MM1-v1's blind day)
